summary: Iteration-4 regression retest of the 6 Phase-3 fixes + sanity pass on Phase-3 happy paths. Backend: 54/54 pytest cases pass (new /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_regressions.py with 9 cases + existing test_phase3/test_phase2/test_auth_security). Frontend: 4 Playwright journeys on the public preview URL (buyer COD checkout -> confirmation/detail copy -> cancel, buyer WELCOME10 + demo Razorpay UPI checkout, seller1 orders-queue advance toast, seller3 CSV bulk upload -> catalogue pending note). ALL 6 REGRESSIONS ARE FIXED AND VERIFIED. Two NEW issues found: (1) backend/.env line 3 is malformed so JWT_SECRET (and CORS_ORIGINS) are never loaded and the app silently falls back to the hardcoded dev secret; (2) POST /api/orders never writes a payment_status field (absent until /payments/verify). Previously-reported minor items still open: non-idempotent admin seed, silent coupon rejection at order time, CategoryPage seller filter showing raw IDs, native sort <select>, stale 'Phase 2 - coming soon' card on seller dashboard.

critical.issue: Line 3 contains two variables with no newline: CORS_ORIGINS="*"JWT_SECRET="3d7f...". dotenv drops BOTH keys (verified: dotenv_values() has no JWT_SECRET and emits 'could not parse statement starting at line 3'). server.py therefore signs/verifies JWTs with the hardcoded fallback 'dev-secret-change-me'. Fix: put JWT_SECRET on its own line.

minor.issue: Created order documents have no payment_status key at all (only set later by /payments/verify). UI works because it relies on a falsy check, but seller queue/COD logic and any strict consumer would break. Set payment_status='pending' (or 'unpaid') at creation.
STILL OPEN from iteration_3: admin is inserted only when missing, so changing ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env never updates the existing hash (playbook expects idempotent seed with password update).
STILL OPEN: an invalid/expired coupon_code is swallowed (discount=0) with no signal to the client, so the charged total can differ from what the buyer saw in the cart.
STILL OPEN: legacy endpoint lets ANY seller/admin advance ANY order (no seller_ids ownership check), unlike /api/seller/orders/{id}/status.

Seller1 queue now shows 83 orders because API regression suites keep creating orders (no order cleanup endpoint). Consider a TEST_ order cleanup path or seeded-buyer scoping; catalogue TEST_ products were cleaned up by this run.

ui_bugs.issue: Stale placeholder card 'Your listings — Product management coming soon.' tagged 'Phase 2' still present although bulk upload exists.

issues: STILL OPEN: Seller filter renders raw truncated IDs ('Seller 1ec6a2', 'Seller e94122') instead of seller business names
STILL OPEN: Sort control is a native browser <select>, not the shadcn Select component
All tile products render the same 3-4 seeded Unsplash images, so the grid looks like one repeated photo

action_items: HIGH: fix backend/.env line 3 (split CORS_ORIGINS and JWT_SECRET onto separate lines) and restart backend — JWT_SECRET is currently NOT loaded and tokens are signed with the hardcoded dev fallback.
Set payment_status ('pending') on order creation in POST /api/orders.
Make admin seeding idempotent (update password_hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes).
Surface coupon rejection at order creation instead of silently zeroing the discount.
Add seller ownership check to (or remove) legacy PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status.
Remove the stale 'Phase 2 / coming soon' card from SellerDashboardPage.
CategoryPage: use seller business_name in the seller filter and replace the native sort <select> with the shadcn Select.
critical_code_review_comments: os.environ.get('JWT_SECRET', 'dev-secret-change-me') hides the broken .env — required security config should fail fast (raise) when missing instead of defaulting.
server.py is 1004 lines and still mixes auth, catalog, orders, payments, seller tools and seeding; split into routers + a seed module.
Order document shape is built inline in create_order without payment_status/razorpay fields; define a single Pydantic/dict builder so payment fields always exist.
SellerOrdersPage advance() derives the toast text via meta.label.replace(/^Mark /,'') — works, but keep an explicit past-tense label per status in NEXT_STATUS to avoid string-munging fragility.
seed_data_creation: API buyers TEST_reg_*/TEST_lock_*/TEST_reset_*/TEST_iso_*/TEST_buyer_* and their orders remain in db (no delete endpoint). All TEST_ products created by bulk-upload tests were deleted (7 stale docs from iteration_3 + 1 UI-created). db.login_attempts cleared so no account is locked out. UI buyer qa_buyer_178857931224@example.com reused: placed 1 COD order (cancelled) and 1 UPI demo-paid order (TM8030C048, later advanced to shipped by seller1).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -p no:randomly -q` (54 tests, all green, ~85s). test_phase3_regressions.py covers coupon-listing/expiry, login lockout (423) incl. counter-reset, bulk-upload seller_verified denormalisation, and the coupon+demo-payment happy path; it cleans its own lockout docs and TEST_ products. Utility scripts: backend/tests/_util_clear_lockouts.py (unstick a locked email) and _util_cleanup_test_products.py (purge TEST_ products + all lockouts). Playwright notes: use [data-testid=seller-login-email/password/submit] (generic input[type=email] selectors flaked and left the form empty); the CSV input [data-testid=csv-file-input] is class='hidden' so call set_input_files directly instead of wait_for_selector(visible); ProductCard pending note renders as uppercase 'PENDING VERIFICATION' via CSS, so assert case-insensitively; toasts are [data-sonner-toast]; cancel-order-btn triggers window.confirm (page.once('dialog', accept)).
rca_of_the_issue: All six reported regressions verified fixed: (1) list_coupons now filters expires_at>now -> GET /api/coupons returns exactly WELCOME10/TERRA200/FIRSTBUY while /coupons/apply EXPIRED10 still 400 'expired'; (2) login uses db.login_attempts with 5-failure/15-min lockout -> 6th attempt 423 and a successful login clears the counter (also verified lockout is per-email); (3) bulk_upload_products sets seller_verified from the seller doc -> seller3 bulk product returns seller_verified=false via /api/products?seller_id=... and its ProductCard renders data-testid=card-pending-note; (4) seller advance toast now reads 'Order marked as Shipped'; (5) COD order detail shows 'Cash on Delivery (pay on delivery)' and a paid UPI order shows 'Paid via UPI'; (6) confirmation page shows 'Total (Cash on Delivery)' for COD and 'Total paid' for demo-paid UPI. NEW: the malformed backend/.env line 3 means JWT_SECRET is never read; because server.py supplies a default, JWTs are signed with 'dev-secret-change-me' — a predictable secret in a deployed environment and a token-invalidation risk once the .env is fixed.
